exemption_credit_phaseout.note: Exemption credits phase out by $6 (single) / $12 (MFJ) per $2,500 of federal AGI over the threshold (2025 thresholds).
exemption_credit_phaseout.note_zh: 免稅額抵稅額在聯邦 AGI 超過門檻後，每 $2,500 遞減 $6（單身）/$12（夫妻合報）（2025 年門檻）。

exemption_phaseout_step.note: Personal exemption reduced by $1,000 per $1,000 of CT AGI over the threshold.
exemption_phaseout_step.note_zh: 個人免稅額在 CT AGI 超過門檻後，每超過 $1,000 遞減 $1,000。

recapture.note: CT tax benefit recapture: portion of the 2% bracket is taxed at 4.5% and recapture payments apply above AGI thresholds (footnote p).
recapture.note_zh: 康州稅賦回補（recapture）：超過 AGI 門檻後，部分 2% 級距改按 4.5% 課稅，並加徵回補金額（註腳 p）。

top_rate_recapture.note: NY tax benefit recapture: when NY AGI exceeds the threshold, tax is the greater of the bracket tax or the top rate applied to all taxable income (2025 indexed thresholds).
top_rate_recapture.note_zh: 紐約州稅賦回補：NY AGI 超過門檻時，稅額取級距稅與最高稅率乘全部應稅所得之較高者（2025 年通膨調整門檻）。

exemption_tiers.note: Ohio personal/dependent exemption tiers by AGI (footnote dd).
exemption_tiers.note_zh: 俄亥俄州個人/扶養免稅額依 AGI 分級（註腳 dd）。

dependent_deduction_all_but_one.note: NM offers a $4,000 deduction for all but one of the taxpayer's dependents (footnote jj).
dependent_deduction_all_but_one.note_zh: 新墨西哥州對「除一名以外的所有扶養人」各提供 $4,000 扣除額（註腳 jj）。

agi_floor.note: If federal AGI exceeds $150,000, VT tax is the greater of the bracket tax or 3% of AGI.
agi_floor.note_zh: 聯邦 AGI 超過 $150,000 時，佛蒙特州稅額取級距稅與 AGI 的 3% 之較高者。

extra_standard_deduction.note: Additional deduction of $1,250 per federal standard deduction box (2025 amount, footnote mm).
extra_standard_deduction.note_zh: 每個聯邦標準扣除額欄位另加 $1,250 扣除額（2025 年金額，註腳 mm）。

standard_deduction_phaseout.note: MN standard deduction reduced by 3% of AGI over $244,400 plus 10% of AGI over $337,800, capped at 80% of the deduction (footnote cc).
standard_deduction_phaseout.note_zh: 明尼蘇達州標準扣除額依 AGI 遞減（超過 $244,400 部分減 3%，超過 $337,800 部分再減 10%），最多減 80%（註腳 cc）。

investment_surtax.note: Approximation: MN 1% surtax on net investment income over $1M, applied to the capital gains input (footnote oo).
investment_surtax.note_zh: 近似處理：明州對超過 $100 萬的淨投資所得課 1% 附加稅，以資本利得輸入值套用（註腳 oo）。

exemption_phaseout_range.note: MD $3,200 exemption phases out linearly over the AGI range (footnote aa).
exemption_phaseout_range.note_zh: 馬里蘭州 $3,200 免稅額在 AGI 區間內線性遞減至零（註腳 aa）。

capital_gains_surtax.note: MD levies an additional 2% surtax on capital gains when AGI exceeds $350,000 (footnote x).
capital_gains_surtax.note_zh: AGI 超過 $350,000 時，馬里蘭州對資本利得加徵 2% 附加稅（註腳 x）。

exemption_credit_limit.note: OR personal exemption credit not allowed if federal AGI exceeds the threshold (footnote ee).
exemption_credit_limit.note_zh: 聯邦 AGI 超過門檻時，俄勒岡州個人免稅額抵稅額不適用（註腳 ee）。

refundable_dependent_credit.note: ME dependent exemption credit is refundable (footnote ww); tax may fall below $0. The $610 credit for dependents under 6 is not modeled.
refundable_dependent_credit.note_zh: 緬因州扶養抵稅額可退還（註腳 ww），稅額可能低於 $0。6 歲以下扶養人 $610 之金額未納入模型。

capital_gains_tax.note: WA 7% excise on capital gains over $278,000 (9% above $1M of taxable gains). Ordinary income is not taxed.
capital_gains_tax.note_zh: 華盛頓州對超過 $278,000 的資本利得課 7% 稅（應稅利得超過 $100 萬部分 9%）。普通所得不課稅。
